title: ROWS returns 1 for non-empty scalars, #VALUE! for blank or omitted args, and #REF! for multi-area references
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, ROWS(array) returns the row count of a single-area reference (up to 1,048,576 for whole columns) or an array, returns 1 for non-empty scalar values (numbers, text, logicals), propagates error values, returns #REF! for multi-area references such as (A1:A3,B1:B2), and returns #VALUE! for blank or omitted arguments.
basis: Measured across cfunc_m3_6 (reference_result row 48, lookup_edges rows 142-147) and jnt_lookup (rows 43-49) in Excel 16.0.20527.20088, and matched across 3,360/3,360 full-bank ROWS rows.
